newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Penas Corp debuts at 24.00 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Penas Corp debuts at 24.00 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Penas Corporation Bhd debuted on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday at 24.00 ringgit against an offer price of 8.00 ringgit per share.
At 0135 GMT the stock was trading at 23.00 ringgit.
Penas made a public issue of 12.84 million shares, amounting to a free float of 32.1 percent.
At 8.00 ringgit, the company has a market capitalisation of 320 million ringgit, according to HLG Securities.
"We are recommending that investors buy up to 17.50 ringgit," HLG Securities said in its report on Penas.
"Penas is an integrated construction company, which can derive the full benefits of having a property arm to feed it with new projects," said HLG Securities.
Penas undertakes piling, mechanical and electrical services for the construction industry.
